svg.title: Tracking Lamaran: Job-hunt tracker with an 11-stage pipeline, 14 fields per application, deadline and interview reminders, and stats.
svg.desc: Project card for Tracking Lamaran, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts. Job-hunt tracker with an 11-stage pipeline, 14 fields per application, deadline and interview reminders, and stats. Built with React, Express, Drizzle, Cloudflare R2, Resend.
